app.name: HOL Guard
app.one_liner: A local AI toolchain guardian that intercepts and vets plugin/tool usage through shims, hooks, and a localhost approval center.

screens.name: Approval Center
screens.purpose: Display pending approvals or resolved blocks for AI tool invocations that couldn't be vetted inline.

rust_commands.name: hol_guard_approvals
rust_commands.purpose: Lists pending approvals or resolves them from terminal.

rust_commands.name: hol_guard_bootstrap
rust_commands.purpose: Detects best local harness, starts approval center, and installs Guard in front of it.

rust_commands.name: hol_guard_receipts
rust_commands.purpose: Shows local approval and block history.

rust_commands.name: hol_guard_run
rust_commands.purpose: Reviews changes before launch and hands blocked sessions to approval center when needed.

rust_commands.name: hol_guard_start
rust_commands.purpose: Shows the next step for detected harnesses.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build local approval center UI
week 1: Implement core interception logic for Codex and Copilot CLI
week 1: Store receipts in SQLite with basic query interface
acceptance_tests: `hol-guard bootstrap` detects existing Claude Code config and installs shim
`hol-guard receipts` shows historical approve/block decisions with timestamps
Blocked `find` pipeline triggers approval center entry visible via `hol-guard approvals`
Running `hol-guard run codex --dry-run` records baseline without launching tool
